Service: - Regular service ensures vehicle safety and performance.
- Service intervals depend on mileage and time.
- The service indicator in the cockpit displays upcoming service deadlines.
- Only qualified workshops should perform maintenance tasks.
Additional service offers: - CUPRA offers extended warranties and maintenance plans.
- Service plans can cover regular inspections and wear parts.
- Check availability and terms through the CUPRA dealer or app.
Vehicle upkeep and cleaning: - Wash the vehicle regularly to preserve paint and prevent corrosion.
- Avoid automatic car washes with brushes if your vehicle has delicate finishes.
- Use only cleaning products recommended by CUPRA.
- Interior surfaces should be cleaned with soft, damp cloths.
- Avoid using high-pressure cleaners on sensitive components like sensors and cameras.
Accessories, spare parts and repair work: - Only use CUPRA-approved accessories and spare parts.
- Non-original parts may affect performance and safety.
- Repairs should be performed by qualified personnel.
- All modifications must comply with legal and manufacturer guidelines.
- Improper repairs may void warranty and reduce vehicle reliability.
